briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate AGI capabilities race amid record compute investments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 major models this month as quarterly AI funding hit $14.9B. Geopolitical tensions rise with US export controls tightening on advanced chips to China.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with multi-agent orchestration while Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI Grok-3 push context windows beyond 2M tokens. DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-4 performance at 30% lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive CAN bus use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500K units monthly as Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions. TSMC reports AI chip revenue up 180% YoY.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
